name: chat-sdk
title: Chat SDK
description: Chat threads from Telegram, Slack (Chat SDK), Discord, and Teams. Use when a task carries a task:chat-sdk contextKey or a user asked through Telegram, Slack, Discord, or Teams. Covers what the swarm posts for you, `chat-reply`, markdown and length per platform, attachments, `chat-read-thread` limits, and channel routes with `register-chat-channel`.
